name: Luck & Magic

features.name: Card reels
features.description: Face-down cards flip over instead of reels spinning.

features.name: Pick a card bonus
features.description: Choose one of five cards to reveal your multiplier.

review:
Luck & Magic replaces traditional reels with face-down cards that flip over after you spin, creating the feeling that magic decides your fate. It has five lines.

In the bonus game, you choose one of five face-down cards. The others are revealed, and then your chosen card shows the multiplier that's applied to your bet. The bonus can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 1,059x maximum and a 96.23% RTP. It's one of BGaming's most unusual presentations, though the maths is close to its other 3x3 bonus games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
